rtt_observation: Each RTT is a 3-probe ICMP ping average; no confidence intervals or calibrated network guarantee
loss_observation: Ping loss uses only 3 ICMP probes; configured loss is not proof of achieved loss
goodput_observation: Received JSON application payload bytes divided by sender-on duration; NOT link throughput or capacity
flow_observation: Counters summed across different flow rules and switches; differences are descriptive, NOT unique packet counts
measurement_scope: One line topology, seed6101, four workloads, three phases; configured TC on h1 interface
recommended_followup: Increase independent seeds and topology coverage; verify TC qdisc runtime values, measure sustained throughput and repeated RTT/loss before claiming fidelity.
